mapper.sql: FROM work w LEFT JOIN source s ON s.id = w.source_id
mapper.select:
SELECT w.id, w.doi, w.title, w.year, w.publication_date, w.source_id, s.title AS source_title, w.authors::text AS authors, w.text_level, COALESCE(w.has_acts, false) AS has_acts
ORDER BY w.publication_date DESC NULLS LAST, w.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: w.id, w.doi, w.title, w.publication_date, w.year, s.title AS source_title, COALESCE(w.first_indexed_at, w.first_seen_at) AS first_indexed
mapper.select:
SELECT
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work_name wn WHERE wn.work_id = w.id AND wn.name_string_id = #{f.name} AND NOT wn.only_reference)
AND COALESCE(w.publication_date, w.first_seen_at::date) >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - #{windowDays} AND COALESCE(w.publication_date, w.first_seen_at::date) <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date + 7 AND (w.publication_date IS NOT NULL OR w.year IS NULL OR w.year >= extract(year FROM (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - #{windowDays}))
ORDER BY COALESCE(w.first_indexed_at, w.first_seen_at) DESC, w.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT w.id, w.doi, w.title, w.year, w.publication_date, w.source_id, s.title AS source_title, w.authors::text AS authors, w.text_level, COALESCE(w.has_acts, false) AS has_acts
WHERE w.state IN ('INDEXED', 'NOTIFIED') AND w.id IN #{i}

SELECT value, count(*) AS cnt FROM ( SELECT
u.v u.v s.journal_type w.year::text w.source_id::text CASE WHEN COALESCE(w.has_acts, false) THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END
AS value
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(w.codes) AS u(v) CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(w.taxgroups) AS u(v)
) t WHERE value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY value ORDER BY cnt DESC, value LIMIT 100

SELECT work_id, name_string_id, name, placement_method, usage_id FROM ( SELECT wn.work_id, wn.name_string_id, ns.name, wn.placement_method, wn.usage_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY wn.work_id ORDER BY wn.salience DESC, wn.name_string_id) AS rn FROM work_name wn JOIN name_string ns ON ns.id = wn.name_string_id WHERE wn.main_subject AND NOT wn.only_reference AND wn.work_id IN #{id} ) t WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY work_id, rn
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work WHERE id = #{workId} AND state IN ('INDEXED', 'NOTIFIED'))
SELECT names_doc_sha FROM work WHERE id = #{workId}

SELECT wn.name_string_id, ns.name, ns.kind, ns.rank, wn.placement_method, wn.usage_id, wn.taxon_path, wn.code, wn.taxgroup, wn.salience, wn.main_subject, wn.only_reference, wn.mention_count, wn.act_types, wn.best_snippet, COALESCE(own.usage_name, other.usage_name) AS usage_name, COALESCE(own.usage_rank, other.usage_rank) AS usage_rank, COALESCE(own.usage_status, other.usage_status) AS usage_status, COALESCE(own.classification, other.classification, '[]'::jsonb)::text AS classification FROM work_name wn JOIN name_string ns ON ns.id = wn.name_string_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT nm.* FROM name_match nm JOIN xr_release r ON r.key = nm.release_key AND r.current WHERE wn.usage_id IS NOT NULL AND nm.name_string_id = wn.name_string_id AND nm.usage_id = wn.usage_id ORDER BY (nm.hint_key = '') DESC, nm.hint_key LIMIT 1) own ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT nm.* FROM name_match nm JOIN xr_release r ON r.key = nm.release_key AND r.current WHERE own.name_string_id IS NULL AND wn.usage_id IS NOT NULL AND nm.usage_id = wn.usage_id ORDER BY nm.name_string_id, nm.hint_key LIMIT 1) other ON true WHERE wn.work_id = #{workId} ORDER BY wn.main_subject DESC, wn.salience DESC, ns.name
